name: Battle Cannon
description: Battle cannons provide powerful, consistent firepower in a compact form.

logicNodes.label: Trigger
logicNodes.description: When true: fires a loaded shell.

logicNodes.label: Open Breech
logicNodes.description: When true: opens the breech to allow shells to be loaded.

logicNodes.label: Loaded
logicNodes.description: Returns true when a shell is loaded and ready to fire.

logicNodes.label: Fuse Timer
logicNodes.description: Sets the optional time-delay fuse in seconds for high-explosive and fragmentation ammo types.
